title: No option for older IOS
review: Great on my phone but app doesn’t work on older iPads unfortunately. Check your OS before making any purchase.

title: Glitchey and inconsistent
review: Was exactly what I wanted, but updating and adding tasks does not always work. Several times I’ve edited something and it won’t save and often when adding tasks the add button is disabled.

title: LOGED ME OUT!
review: I cliked on the app and randomly I get loged out

title: A lot of bugs tech issues
review: It’s a pretty decent app. I got a new phone and the information does not save it recognizes my login, but just keeps glitching and won’t allow me to proceed. The app is paid for & it does not work. If you switch phones you will lose everything

title: Thank you
review: My kid was so unorganized and now she is the most organized person I know. Life changing!!

title: App not working for a week now
review: Have so many issues with the app. App logged me out randomly and now I can’t get logged in. Every time I put in my password the app just reloads. I pay for the subscription so this is quite frustrating.

title: Must have for parents
review: I don’t usually review but this app is so good. Even the free version is worth it. Tho I don’t mind paying for a subscription worth every penny. Kid looks forward to chores now I can’t believe it lol.

title: What happened?
review: Had this app about 2 years now & as of today, it’s no longer working. Tried to email support, but the email did not go thru.

title: Great but please fix
review: This app has been great! My kids are motivated to do chores and it keeps us organized. However, three days into using it all of my children’s tasks and rewards have disappeared. This app needs bug fixes!!! Please fix it cause we love it when it works!

title: SIGNED OUT
review: I would have done 5 stars but today, the app completely logged my son out as well as myself. All of our task and rewards are gone. I try to log back in but it’s not working.

title: Easy & Rewarding
review: My son and i have been loving tracking his tasks and rewards through this app. He loves the ability to check off and keep track of his points and he’s been driven to get more and more done to earn his rewards! I love how driven he is and the ease in which i can set up custom rewards. The only thing i would change is being able to set the tasks for certain days or every couple days that dont need done daily. Otherwise would recommend!

title: Really like it
review: My kids really enjoy this app over a regular paper chore chart. Much more fun to click off the chores and see the points add up immediately. I would like to see repeat rewards options for rewards that are repeated. And I do think the price seems high for the app. I wanted to get one of the organizer tablet but didn’t want more stuff. The app is a good compromise but the annual price makes me think I should eventually just get one since it evens out without a continuous fee.

title: Can’t even try it
review: The app won’t let me get past the login screen. I log in, it pops up the next screen, and then immediately cycles back to the login screen. I’ve tried numerous times.

title: Didn’t even load
review: I was looking at few different apps and this one seemed really great, however I never got a chance to find out because it kept glitching and I couldn’t even create a profile for my child. Every time I clicked done, it wouldn’t even load or move forward. What a shame. Definitely needs some technical assistance

title: Costs to share to others
review: Free unless you want to share to other people

title: Like it but….
review: I’m using this for my 14 year old who has ADHD and gets easily distracted. I tested 7 other chore checklist apps and even though this one is more “babyish looking “ it’s easy to navigate a straight to the point . Some suggestions-1.having  a calendar to see the whole month and future dates like it shows on the feature pictures for the app. 2. Having a completed section or crossed out for completed tasks  / parental lock once the child marks a task as completed. Once tasks are completed parent could then uncheck if tacks weren’t completed and send reminder notification to child’s device 3. Having notifications to parent phone once a child completes each or all tasks similar to when the child receives notifications when a parent creates new task. There is an option of a daily reminder but it can only be set to 1 time. My child have morning and evening chores so the 1 reminder doesn’t help

title: Perfect solution
review:
We’ve been looking for a simple solution for tracking chores.

This has been working great for us. Have it setup on a tablet the kids have access to.

Kids can easily switch between accounts and track their chores.

title: THE BEST
review: This has inspired and taught my children to be excited about doing tasks to completion and to respect the accountability with the pictures function.  It’s been incredible! I can’t wait to see the additional features and updates to come along!

title: Great!
review: The app is great but it made me sign up and pay so I can’t get the app sorry

title: Good app overall, family is enjoying it, few bugs
review: I’m enjoying this app so far, and my kids are too. They are old enough to navigate it and understand. It can be a little buggy at times. On my end deleting certain tasks doesn’t necessarily make them go away, it appears to be a bug. If a child doesn’t complete a task it carries over which is a good thought in premise but it creates duplicates, so then you have to delete a duplicate but then you have the delete bug. So that’s a bit frustrating currently. I do agree with others, a better history option to review what’s been completed and points redeemed. But I think the developers are on the right track and I hope they keep at it as I think this has a ton of potential!

title: Not perfect, but we’ll try to make it work
review: It establishes a good system, but it could be better in my opinion.  One thing I noticed is that kids can mark off tasks themselves.  I don’t think that’s ideal.  At least provide an option that gives parents the flexibility of allowing kids to mark off their own tasks as completed.  Rewards could be better.  Once they redeem an award it just disappears.  There’s a record of it being redeemed, but again, not an ideal way to track rewards.  And it’s annoying that you have to create the rewards again after it’s redeemed.  Would be better if it was more of a rewards shop.  After your child buys/redeems a reward, that reward goes into his/her inventory.  Then when he/she actually uses the reward, it can get removed from the inventory.  Similar to how RPG games work.  Right now we’re in trial and still exploring the app, but if it doesn’t work out for us, we won’t buy.

title: Loved it at first
review: Worked great until I got a new phone and when I logged in from it, my premium account was still there but my kids’ profiles and allll the tasks and rewards we had created and saved were gone. It took a lot of time to set up all the tasks initially, so I’m tempted to just buy a Skylight before I sit down and go through that process all over again; bc also, this obviously will not be the last time I have to get a new device.

title: Hidden fees
review: I wanted to add a second kid, unfortunately they charge you for more than one but don’t tell you that until you’re all the way through signing in and adding the app to your child’s device. I now have to delete everything, unsubscribe from their emails and find another one to use.

title: Almost everything
review:
I have a few things I’d love to see adjusted to where I would be willing to pay for it. 1. Make the images bigger so kids can see better. My kids can’t read yet so they need the photos. 2. Have the completed items disappear from the to do items and go into a completed list so that they can easily understand what’s been completed and what still needs done today. It’s too cluttered and hard for little ones to scroll to see what else needs done. 3. Create a penalties section so we can dock stars for bad behavior etc. 
the purpose of a chore app is to create less work for the parent and right now the way it is, it’s not really taking the work off my plate because now I have to sit down with them to check off items vs just telling them

title: Fun and rewarding
review: I am a kid and I used to not like chores, but now they're fun. You do the tasks to earn stars everyday and you can redeem them for fun, customized rewards.

title: It’s perfect but…..
review: It’s amazing although I do have a complaint. It’s just that it takes three to six times to turn the the chore in. So if you could please fix that it’s would be perfect. Thanks again😬🙏✨

title: Can’t Log in after paying the $50 lifetime plan
review: I bought the lifetime plan for $50 and one day later I am locked out of the account and I’m not able to log back in. I have contacted customer service. I will update my review if I hear back from them within 48 hours and the issue is fixed. Otherwise, I’ll pursue a full refund.

title: Awesome!
review: Chore charts have always been a pain for us. Updating them, making sure they’re marked off, tracking their chores with tickets/beads. This makes the process seamless! I love the feature for photo submission for their chores too! My only suggestion would be to have an option to set up AM/PM chores so they can easily see what needs to be done in the morning before school and what should be done after school. I know you can set a time for each chore but I think for young kids it would be easier for them to see the distinction.

title: Star Chart Made Easy!
review: It’s the best app to customize chores to earn stars. You can create tasks on your app/parent while your kids mark it off on their kids app on their tablet or phone! You can also ask for photo proof for them to get their star(s). Also included a customizable reward page. Get away from buying just toys with their stars and add things like: going to the zoo for 50 stars or pick the family movie for 20 stars, etc.  Wish I found this app sooner! I can’t recommend it enough. 🥰🫠🤩😍

title: Kid’s devices?
review: I want to love this so much. But my children don’t have their own devices so I’m at a loss I guess. I thought that I just set up profiles for each kid on my phone and let them tap the chore when completed. But each kid’s profile has a code that they have to enter from their own devices. Which my kids don’t have. Is there a work around for this? There’s no clear instructions from beginning to end anywhere that I can find in the app or on the website to explain it either.

title: It’s decent
review: I think this app needs more work on it because when I first got on it it immediately make me make passwords and it kept saying that it was wrong but when I tried to make tasks it would not let me do the task it’s a great app but it needs more work.😀

title: Alarmas
review: Faltaría agregarle las alarmas para que le pueda avisar de cada tarea

title: AMAZING APP!
review: Love the app! Kids are already so into phones/tablets that this is great. My husband loves it and I do too. Makes them start to earn things!

title: Mostly there
review: Prior to discovering this app we were essentially using pennies to accomplish the same thing. This app has made things way easier. There are still a few features that I wish we could have. One being a task that is due once a week or some other frequency but doesn’t necessarily need to be done on a specific day. So it appears as an option at the start of the week and will continue to show until it’s done and then won’t show anymore until next week. Or three times a week etc. Another feature that would be nice is shared tasks where any child can do it but as soon as one does it then the task disappears from everyone’s list.

title: Good app with some issues
review: It works really good for my 8 year old twins but I wish items wouldn’t keep getting moved out of order. I’m not sure what’s causing this and it can be confusing when we have things that needs to be done in a certain order.

title: Bugs
review: The app worked great for the first day. On day 2 I lost all chore and reward data. I tried updating the app to see if it resolved my issues and was force logged out without a way to log back in. I tried to create a new account, but could not get past the add kid step without the app freezing. Completely unusable at this point.

title: Dissappointed
review: I got this App a few days ago and paid for premium. It worked fine for the first two days but today it’s glitching and not showing the checklist this evening. Very upsetting as my kids really liked it. If it’s fixed I’d give it 5 stars, but if it’s a consistent problem it’s useless.

title: Almost perfect
review: We love this app. It keeps our kids on track and is exciting enough that they have not lost interest. I do wish that there were multiple ways to keep track of and give more rewards. It would be nice if they could redeem daily rewards while keeping track of their overall stars for bigger rewards. Other than that, we all love it

title: Some bugs
review: Overall, I think this is a great app. It really helped my kids feel more motivated to get their chores done. They like feeling accomplished by marking off their chores. Really my only issue is that despite the kids receiving their stats for the day it is not showing me that they completed the chore. Even when they have picture proof of doing said chore. Some days it works and others it’s got nothing. If this were fixed I would for sure give 5*!

title: AMAZING!!
review: This app is so amazing because I can give me child chores and give her rewards! This is a life saver because she hated chores and now it is so fun for her! Thank you so much!!

title: Good app
review: Really like the app. Helping kids to take responsibility. Kids do need to have their own device with app. Your phone becomes the parent side. The app does freeze up repeatedly as kids are trying to submit their photos though.

title: App is a waste of money
review: Do not purchase this app its a waste of money! Dose not work properly. Any time one of my children would check off something and then another would switch to their account all of the points would just disappear and they would have to start all over again, and then the app started to check things off from other days all by itself.

title: Simple and kid motivating
review: We have only used it for several days, but it’s really motivating my kids to make good habits through out the day!  I love the simple design and kid friendly view. I do want to request that an update be made for the task to stay completed once it’s marked “checked”. It’s frustrating for my little to not see her progress through the day. And for a busy mom not to see what has been completed. Thank you so much!

title: Not bad
review: Not bad but still needs to be polished. I wish the rewards can be set permanently so I don’t have to recreate always.  Also I’d like to see a feature rewards opposite feature when kid misses a chore and I could apply a penalty.

title: BEST CHORE APP HANDS DOWN!
review: This app is EVERYTHING! It motivates my 5 and 9 year olds to get things done because they want those rewards! I love all the little details like adjusting days things are due, requiring photo proof, and being able to make your own token awards and amounts! Everything was SO thought out! I have told all my friends about this app! Great job everyone! (And it kept me from spending $300 on a digital wall calendar for the sake of chore lists)

title: Can't upload pics and need more icons
review:
Love how you're able to purchase the app for a lifetime. 

Other apps charges a monthly fee. 

The app is friendly user. 

Only problem is , can't upload photos atm... need more icons selections. 

Also , it WOULD be nice if we can look back on the days that passed to see what our kids completed. 

Please have more than one primary ... like for mom and dad to keep track of their children.

title: Awesome
review: Like this new app

title: Love this app
review: Fantastic app for getting kids involved in chores! It’s fun, easy to use, and keeps my kids motivated with rewards👏🏿
